business_purpose: Channel carries the strength of the intake signal: a named branch or partner referral is a warmer, pre-qualified introduction than an unsolicited digital form.
available_at_decision: First source touch at or before the decision
notes: Channel also sets the assignment SLA (SLA-04A/B/C)

business_purpose: An explicitly stated product need is declared intent, not an inference. Credit interest is the strongest declared commercial signal in the hypothetical process.
Larger in-scope SMEs carry more business-banking need. Only validated bands count; unknown is treated as weak evidence, not as zero.
available_at_decision: Prospect record at or before the decision
notes: 500-plus is outside the 1-499 eligibility band (RT-E03) and is normally gated out before scoring

component_name: Industry context and specialist requirement level
business_purpose: Industries with a mandatory or preferred specialist rule are where the hypothetical bank has declared coverage intent; unclassified industry is weak evidence, not zero.
available_at_decision: Prospect record at or before the decision
notes: Sector 91 (public administration) is excluded by SPC-08 and gated out before scoring

business_purpose: External public-data market signal for the lead's CMA under the declared scenario. Capped so that geography can never dominate the lead score.
available_at_decision: Market marts are external public data, period-independent of the decision
notes: Tier 3 scale-only and missing-context leads take the declared neutral value 50, never 0 (BR-009)

business_purpose: A complete record can be worked immediately; an incomplete one costs RM time. Six declared items are checked.
available_at_decision: Lead and prospect fields as at the decision
notes: Items: geography resolved; territory resolved; employee band known; industry classified; product interest stated; contact consent recorded

business_purpose: How long the lead has been waiting. Older leads cost conversion opportunity and prospect goodwill.
available_at_decision: captured_at is strictly before the decision

business_purpose: Consumption of the in-flight intake, validation, duplicate-review or assignment clock (SLA-01, SLA-02, SLA-03, SLA-04A/B/C) at the decision instant.
transformation: (as_of - started_at) / (target_at - started_at) on clocks started strictly before as_of and not stopped before as_of; maximum across clocks
available_at_decision: Clock must have started strictly before the decision
notes: No in-flight clock takes the declared neutral value 30

business_purpose: Consumption of the in-flight acknowledgement, first-contact, follow-up, inactivity, reassignment or escalation clock (SLA-05, SLA-06A-D, SLA-07, SLA-08A/B, SLA-09, SLA-10) at the decision instant.
transformation: (as_of - started_at) / (target_at - started_at) on clocks started strictly before as_of and not stopped before as_of; maximum across clocks
available_at_decision: Clock must have started strictly before the decision
notes: Applies mainly to reassignment, override and queue-release decisions

business_purpose: Work already invested before a reassignment or override decision: contact attempts made and whether two-way contact was reached.
transformation: state derived from activities strictly before as_of
available_at_decision: Activities strictly before the decision only
notes: Never uses activities at or after the decision
